answer: Re-attestations are stored in thread and signal lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the bridge graph. Verification costs 9 dollars and 2 days per identity, which turns a 742 account sybil into a 4 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
